name: Temperature Sensor
description: Measures air temperature for monitoring comfort or weather changes.

name: Heat Sensor
description: Detects warmth from objects and appliances.

name: Pressure Sensor
description: Senses pressure changes for simple environmental experiments.

name: Infrared Sensor
